description: How many posts the brand’s Instagram account can still publish in Instagram’s rolling 24-hour window: used, total and LEFT. Check it before a bulk schedule, and read it the moment Instagram starts refusing posts: a quota refusal otherwise looks like a broken connection, and reconnecting cannot fix it. A carousel counts as one post. A number comes back null when Instagram did not report it, never 0. Read-only, 0 credits. Needs Instagram connected (through Meta or Instagram Login).

account.description: which Instagram account — an @handle or id from list_connector_accounts("instagram"); omit when there is one

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

pageId.description: Facebook Page id — omit when only one Page is connected

name: instagram_publishing_limit
title: Instagram posts left today
